adapters.note: The adapter ships as @askturret/mcp-adapters-fastify and is published on npm. Its exports are mcpFromOpenApi and fastifyMcp. There is no fromFastify export and there never has been: earlier revisions of this matrix listed it as stable API, which was wrong when written rather than a symbol that was later removed.

sources.note: Version detection matches the dotted prefixes '3.0.' and '3.1.' against the document's openapi field. A document declaring exactly "3.0" or "3.1" with no patch segment is rejected; write "3.0.0" or "3.1.0".

mcp.negotiationNote: This value is reported in the initialize result and is not negotiated against the version the client requests.

sdk.floorReason: ^1.24.0 is the first range GHSA-w48q-cv73-mx4w considers patched (#140). packages/transports/src/sdk-peer-range.test.ts fails if either declaration drops below it. Until matrix 2.0.0 this file published ^0.5.0 — the line the code had already excluded for that advisory.
sdk.isolation: The SDK is imported by packages/transports only; it is not part of any public API surface.

contract.policy: Changes to this matrix require a semver bump and a release-notes entry. Removing support for a listed version, or narrowing a supported range, is a breaking change and requires a major version bump. Adding a newly supported version is a minor release.
contract.authority: This file is the source of truth: if it and docs/compatibility.md disagree, this file governs. NOTE that the .md is NOT generated from this file — no generator exists and no check compares them. They are maintained by hand in parallel and must be edited together in the same change. An earlier revision described the .md as 'the human-readable rendering of it', which asserted a derivation that has never been built.
contract.enforcement: This matrix is a published statement, not a CI-enforced guarantee. Running the suite against every cell is tracked separately by Epic #5.
